entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF77-091B. Can you process that?
I can certainly look into that order for you. Just to understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
There's no issue. The box is unopened. I just don't want it anymore. The color wasn't right. Is it returnable, yes or no?
Okay, I understand. I'm pulling up your order now... VF77-091B. I see the Aero Road Helmet. It looks like this was delivered 83 days ago.
Right. So, can I return it?
Let me just confirm the policy. One moment... Yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 83, I can absolutely approve this for you.
Good. Finally. What do I need to do?

I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can just print it, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off. We want to ensure your on-road safety with gear you're completely happy with. Since the original box is unopened, that makes it very simple.
Okay. I see the email. That's all?

That's everything for the return. Also, I see you're one of our VIP customers, so I've gone ahead and added a 15% discount code to that email as a thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit. You can use it on your next order.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
